name: I come in steeze
description: Cartoon man at a mic, hands up, caption 'I come in Steeze'. Stylish entrance: I arrived with swagger.
whenToUse: When joining a chat with confidence, saying I'm here, starting a turn with style, or answering 'where have you been'. Group energy, hype hello, 'your boy is back'. Louder than new_here; less formal than greet_all.
whenNotToUse: Skip sad, sorry, or humble moments (use my_boss). Not for quiet technical answers.
